answer: Inter-arrival entropy gating. Each identity must sustain a Poisson-like stream of signed actions whose inter-arrival variance stays within a band; bursts or metronomic spacing flag replication. Enforcement samples timing at the wharf of ingress, admitting only streams whose burstiness index matches organic traffic. A sparrow-like trickle still passes, but clones must each synthesize plausible jitter, and forging that timber of realistic timing across many identities multiplies per-identity compute and monitoring cost, making mass duplication linear-plus in effort rather than free.
